versions.changelog: Synchronize Shopify Skill Hub onboarding and runtime configuration improvements.
Release v2.1.0: expanded Markets, localization, shipping, storefront, and international SEO audit workflow.
Release 2.0.0: unified SemVer and safer onboarding metadata.

Initial release of the Shopify Markets Localization Auditor skill.

- Audits Shopify international setup across Markets, languages, shipping zones, storefront localization, and basic international SEO.
- Generates an easy-to-read HTML report with plain-language findings.
- Calculates locale translation readiness using Shopify Admin API, per defined resource scope.
- Previews and applies approved fixes for Markets, locale publishing, and localization issues (approval required before any changes).
- Flags issues for manual review where strategy or store structure is unclear.
- Strictly avoids theme editing, translation-writing, feed tasks, tax setup, and generic SEO/content rewriting.
